facts.fact: Vividata is an audience measurement tool that conducts approximately 38,000 surveys annually to collect attitudes and behaviours of Canadian consumers.
facts.quote: It’s an audience measurement tool that collects attitudes and behaviours of Canadian consumers by conducting approximately 38,000 surveys annually.

facts.fact: Nielsen states that it measures more than half of the world's total broadcast, print and online advertising.
facts.unit: share of world's total broadcast, print and online advertising
facts.quote: Nielsen measures more than half of the world’s total broadcast, print and online advertising.

facts.fact: Adweek has covered advertising, media and technology news since 1978.
facts.quote: Since 1978, they’ve covered many notable shifts in media, and they’re not stopping any time soon.

facts.fact: Nielsen estimates advertising expenditure using what it calls 'spot monitoring methodology'.
facts.quote: They estimate advertising expenditure through what they refer to as “spot monitoring methodology”.
